newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kmart buy reiterated.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said Thursday it reiterated its buy recommendation on retailer Kmart Corp.
-- Kmart on Wednesday reported a 5.3 percent rise in same store sales for the five-weeks ended July 2, which Gruntal said was in line with expectations.
-- Kmart also said it expects second quarter net income will be below a year ago, although it will post a profit.

-- "We still believe that there are good long term prospects for Kmart which should have a stronger second half with the help of back-to-school, Christmas, the contined Big Kmart conversions and a greater number of 'Pantry' stores," Gruntal said.
